NOTICE OF WAIVER OF ORAL ARGUMENT AS TO PLAINTIFE’S MOTION
FOR LEAVE TO FILE A SUPPLEMENTAL MEMORANDUM

Plaintiff waives oral argument on Plaintiff's Motion for Leave to File a Supplemental
Memorandum in Support of His Rule 26(d)(1) Motion, ECF No. 15, and requests that the Court
determine the motion on the papers under Local Civil Rule 7(J).

This notice addresses only the present motion for leave. This notice does not modify any
pending request concerning oral argument on ECF No. 15 or ECF No. 54, including the relief

requested in ECF Nos. 66-68.
